date.description: the successor's creation date is what the lifecycle window reads; prepare_gleif.py already truncated it to the calendar day, so this only refuses a malformed value

remove.description: a bad date must drop the value, not the entity: CREATION_DATE is a strict date, so a raw value would fail the entire document on index

date.description: the predecessor's shutdown date is what the lifecycle window reads; a missing one makes the predecessor undated

remove.description: a bad date must drop the value, not the entity: SHUTDOWN_DATE is a strict date, so a raw value would fail the entire document on index

set.description: HQ_LOCAL is the street qualified by its town, FDIC's STREET_LOCAL shape (FDIC hazard 5): compared on the street alone, every bare 'Main Street' matched every other across regions at 1.0. A missing city or region leaves it absent rather than town-less, because '<street> | ' would again match every namesake street with no town
set.if: ctx.HQ_STREET != null && ctx.HQ_STREET.toString().trim() != '' && ctx.HQ_CITY != null && ctx.HQ_CITY.toString().trim() != '' && ctx.HQ_REGION != null && ctx.HQ_REGION.toString().trim() != ''
